mentions.name: Tunemark
mentions.description: An Android app that lets users add bookmarks to moments in songs and easily jump back to them. It is designed for practicing dancing or music, where you need to constantly reset to specific parts of songs. Unlike DJ-type apps, Tunemark works alongside most music apps, including streaming services. A first update is in progress, adding bookmark sharing, possibly BPM detection, and quality-of-life improvements such as better UI scalability for different screen sizes and split-screen use.
mentions.problem: When practicing dancing or music, you need to constantly reset back to specific parts of songs, which regular music apps don't make easy.
mentions.audience: People practicing dancing or music who need to repeatedly jump back to specific parts of songs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm slowly but surely working on a first update to my Android app, Tunemark (https://tunemark.app), which I released a while ago. Tunemark lets you add bookmarks to moments in songs so that it is easy to jump back to them. It is really convenient when practicing dancing or music and you need to constantly reset back to specific parts of songs.
